name: IR-5 "Intimidator"
description: The IR-5 "Intimidator" was a rapid-fire blaster pistol manufactured by Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.. It was slightly less powerful than a standard blaster pistol, but compensated for this with a rate of fire akin to a repeating blaster and an integrated targeting computer to improve the weapon's accuracy.

data.name: IR-5 "Intimidator"
data.cost: 750—1,225 credits (25 credits per power pack, 200 for retractable stock)
